items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bill Holman's past representation of Tony Williams, but the interviewee's direct interaction is with Holman, not Williams.

ctx.x: How is he to work with? I met him because of my association through NARAS [National Association of Recording Arts and Sciences]. One of the first times I met him, he said he was – he had represented Tony Williams. Of course that made me perk up. How long has that relationship been?

About 20 years, I think. I think he was a promotion guy before, something like that. He was a tenor player also. He‟s always kept one foot in jazz, an interest. He‟s had some health problems too. So I don‟t know how long he‟s going to be going, but he‟s still
